official_scoring.round_score: Episode win indicators, including shared first-place ties, averaged across the episodes assigned to the policy in that round.
official_scoring.division_score: EWMA of valid completed-round scores with a 24-round half-life, displayed after multiplication by 100.

participation_finding.verdict: The apparent partial participation is deterministic roster allocation, not evidence that current players voluntarily select individual episodes.

map_finding.observed_schedule: World on even rounds and Pangaea on odd rounds for every round from 732 through 751.
map_finding.verdict: Map is forecastable in this window, but Captain has no pre-round sure-win cell. The strongest observed cell won only 4/10, the map difference is not yet statistically decisive, and all four Captain positions are bundled into one round.

control_surface.verdict: Do not use retirement and resubmission as a per-round switch. The entrant snapshot is sealed before episode requests, and the operation risks losing the live seat.

operator_policy_update.scope: Future Captain Underpants candidate only; do not mutate Mickey Mouse or qd1n by implication.
operator_policy_update.alliances: Tactical, optional, and breakable. No player receives permanent protection by K1Z identity or name.
operator_policy_update.targeting: Any rival, including K1Z Mickey Mouse, may be attacked or eliminated when the deterministic controller estimates that doing so improves Captain's chance to finish first.

decision.reason: No current player skipped any of the measured rounds, no sure-win pre-entry signal exists, and Captain's observed Pangaea-only mean of 20 percent cannot converge above the current 27.249-point leader if that rate persists.
decision.next_arm: Keep continuous participation. Build a Captain-scoped map-and-seat intent controller with tactical alliances and no identity protection, then require a replay-bound improvement above the current leader-rate threshold before promotion.
